title: Memory Errors Collapsible
description: The Memory errors/warnings like non-standard tags can take up too much room. It should be expandable, with the default being collapsed and including the number of warnings for easier at a glance audits. Screenshot reference: Screenshot 2026-05-25 103635.png (local account path omitted from repo task content; attach or copy a sanitized asset before PR).

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented collapsed Memory diagnostics panels for both selected memories and draft diagnostics. The default view now shows a compact Diagnostics/Draft Diagnostics summary with the warning/error count, and expanding reveals the detailed rows. Result-list diagnostic chips remain visible for quick scanning. Validation: dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo passed; browser probe on /memories confirmed a selected memory renders collapsed as 'Diagnostics 5' and expands to non-standard tag warning rows on click; route-smoke passed 6/6 against http://127.0.0.1:5099.
